findings.title: stop_daemon.py raises SyntaxError on import
findings.description: from __future__ import annotations placed after sys.path bootstrap statements. Python requires future-imports at the top of the file. python stop_daemon.py fails immediately.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Phase-1 sys.path shim was prepended above the future import by tools/_phase1_move.py.
findings.suggested_fix: Move 'from __future__ import annotations' to line 1 (first non-comment line).
findings.impact_on_trading: Operational only: emergency kill switch unusable; cannot trigger money loss directly but extends MTTR on a runaway daemon.

findings.title: Live-order retry path has no idempotency key, can cause duplicate fills on broker timeout
findings.description: _live_order_with_retry retries placeOrder up to retry_attempts (default 3) on any Exception. AngelOne placeOrder is non-idempotent server-side. A network timeout after broker commit produces a second order on retry, bypassing all position-sizing gates which run before order placement.
findings.reproduction: Mock SmartAPI.placeOrder with side_effect=[requests.Timeout, 'AO_42']; observe two placeOrder calls without any orderBook lookup in between.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No client_ref / userref / ordertag passed in order_params; no pre-retry order-book check.
findings.suggested_fix: 1) Generate a stable client_ref per intent (uuid). 2) Pass as 'ordertag' (AngelOne supports it). 3) Before any retry, query orderBook() and skip if any row contains client_ref; build result from that row instead.
findings.impact_on_trading: Direct money loss: 2x-3x over-fill at potentially worse prices on a single bad network burst. Position-sizing limits do NOT catch it because they fire before placement.

findings.title: SSL verification disabled by default; insecure cloud deploy on any operator who copies .env.example
findings.description: TRADER_DISABLE_SSL_VERIFY defaults to 'true' (bypass enabled). Hard-coded verify=False in stock_scanner. urllib3.disable_warnings at module import. MITM-vulnerable HTTPS to AngelOne unless operator explicitly opts in to secure.
findings.reproduction: ssl.create_default_context().verify_mode is CERT_NONE after main.py import with env-var unset.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Polarity inverted; designed for corp-laptop convenience, never re-evaluated for cloud.
findings.suggested_fix: 1) Default TRADER_DISABLE_SSL_VERIFY to 'false' in main.py and run_daemon.py. 2) Replace verify=False in stock_scanner.py with a config-driven flag. 3) Update .env.example to call out the polarity flip.
findings.impact_on_trading: Compromised proxy or upstream CA can falsify order confirmations, fund balances, or harvest JWT. Bandit B501 High/High.

findings.title: feed_token captured but never written to config; WebSocket auth fails the day use_websocket is enabled
findings.description: connect_angelone assigns feed_token = api.getfeedToken() to a local that is never read. WebSocketClient._run_angelone reads broker_cfg.get('feed_token', '') which stays empty. SmartWebSocketV2 then fails auth and the WS background thread dies silently (per the P1 #13 reconnect path).
findings.reproduction: Set data_pipeline.use_websocket: true; observe AngelOne WS auth error in logs.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: main.connect_angelone bypasses the AngelOneBroker class wrapper which DOES plumb feed_token correctly (packages/brokers/angelone.py:136).
findings.suggested_fix: After successful session in main.connect_angelone, set config.setdefault('broker', {})['feed_token'] = feed_token before returning api.
findings.impact_on_trading: Live-mode safety: WS-based exits (P0/P1 SL/TP propagation) regress to REST poll cadence ~15s. Combined with B-2 timing, exits could miss intra-bar moves.

findings.title: GNFC mapped to two different sectors in same dict literal; second value silently wins
findings.description: Ruff F601: 'GNFC': 'Chemicals' at line 246 overwritten by 'GNFC': 'Agri' at line 311. Python dict literals silently keep the last value. Sector-exposure cap routes GNFC to Agri, missing Chemicals concentration risk when held alongside TATACHEM/RCF/FACT.
findings.reproduction: from core.market_safety import NSE_SECTOR_MAP; assert NSE_SECTOR_MAP['GNFC'] == 'Agri' (instead of the intended Chemicals).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Manual sector-map maintenance, no de-duplication test.
findings.suggested_fix: Pick the correct sector classification (operator decision), keep one entry, add unit test that parses the AST of market_safety.py and asserts no duplicate dict keys. PFC is also duplicated (line 179, 268) but with same value NBFC; harmless but worth de-duping for hygiene.
findings.impact_on_trading: Real-money: sector-concentration risk control mis-fires for GNFC + chemicals book; supersector rollup does not bridge Chemicals + Agri so it doesn't compensate.

findings.title: Hardcoded NSE holiday calendar ends 2026-12-25; 2027 trading days fail open
findings.description: NSE_HOLIDAYS set ends at 2026-12-25. After 2027-01-01 the agent will attempt to trade on 2027 holidays. Trading on Republic Day 2027 (2027-01-26) is the first concrete failure.
findings.reproduction: Mock datetime.now(IST) -> 2027-01-26; observe is_market_open() returns True.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Annual manual maintenance not in operator runbook.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a startup assertion: assert max(NSE_HOLIDAYS) >= today + 180 days else log.critical. Longer term: auto-fetch from NSE archives once a year.
findings.impact_on_trading: Operational: any 2027 holiday becomes a trading day where the agent burns commissions and risks weekend-overhang behavior.

findings.title: _paper_order uses unseeded global random; backtests are not bitwise reproducible
findings.description: Slippage and partial-fill simulation draw from the global random module without seeding. Two runs of the same backtest yield different P&L tables. Pollutes battery comparisons; the 2026-05-25 V2-vs-V3 forensic had to SHA-256 the trade ledgers to prove identity elsewhere.
findings.reproduction: Run two identical 'python main.py backtest' invocations; diff the resulting trade CSVs.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: RNG seed never threaded through to ExecutionEngine.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject a deterministic per-run rng via constructor (config.execution.rng_seed, default 1729); replace random.uniform/random with self._rng.* calls; propagate from BacktestConfig.
findings.impact_on_trading: Research-trust: invalidates the per-variant trade-count differences in the freeze-v2.1 battery comparisons. Live trading unaffected.

findings.title: Alert dedup state file is process-unsafe; 2026-05-13 EOD-email storm could recur during overlapping Docker restarts
findings.description: Read-modify-write on logs/.alert_dedup_state.json with no OS file lock. Atomic os.replace protects file integrity but not dedup semantics. Two concurrent daemons (Docker restart spawning new container before SIGTERM ack) can both miss the dedup check.
findings.reproduction: Spawn two child processes that each call send_alert('EOD','body'); mock the email backend; assert exactly 1 send, observe 2.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Single-process semantics assumed at design time.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap load->modify->save in an OS file lock (fcntl on POSIX, msvcrt on Windows, or portalocker for cross-platform). Or migrate state to SQLite with UNIQUE(fingerprint) ON CONFLICT IGNORE for single-statement atomicity.
findings.impact_on_trading: Operational: repeat of the 11-EOD-email incident on the next overlapping container restart.

findings.title: DataHandler._cache is unbounded; long-lived daemon leaks RAM across trading days
findings.description: Cache key includes start_date.date()_end_date.date(); each new trading day adds entries without eviction. Estimated ~270 MB after 90 days on a 300-symbol watchlist.
findings.reproduction: Run for a week, monitor psutil.Process.memory_info().rss; observe monotonic growth.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Cache added for backtesting where keys are bounded; not adapted for live daemon.
findings.suggested_fix: Use collections.OrderedDict with max_size=512 and move_to_end on access; popitem(last=False) when over capacity.
findings.impact_on_trading: Performance: 1 GB OCI Ampere VM eventually OOMs or thrashes swap.

findings.title: SMTP login uses display-format sender as username; SMTP fallback path broken
findings.description: server.login(self._email_cfg['sender'], ...) is called with 'Trading Agent <foo@x.com>' style display string. SMTP requires plain email as username; Gmail/Outlook365/SES return 535.
findings.suggested_fix: Use email.utils.parseaddr to extract addr-spec before calling server.login.
findings.impact_on_trading: Observability: the day Resend rate-limits, the SMTP fallback silently breaks and alerts (including EOD email) stop arriving without an alert.

findings.title: run_daemon._write_idle_heartbeat reports cash:0 always
findings.description: Reads config.get('initial_capital', 0.0) — wrong key. Actual key is capital.initial_balance. health.json idle heartbeat shows cash:0 every minute during off-hours.
findings.reproduction: Stop daemon, inspect logs/health.json after the first idle-heartbeat tick.
findings.suggested_fix: cash = float((config.get('capital') or {}).get('initial_balance', 0.0))
findings.impact_on_trading: Observability: watchdog and tools/health_check read cash:0 during off-hours, may misclassify as drained.

findings.title: secrets.apply_env_to_config overwrites real YAML values with .env.example placeholders that look real
findings.description: _is_placeholder treats 're_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' (Resend placeholder in .env.example) as non-placeholder; apply_env_to_config then overwrites the YAML value with the bogus example string. Resend then 401s; alerts silently spool to logs/failed_alerts/.
findings.reproduction: Copy .env.example to .env unmodified; observe Resend 401 in logs/failed_alerts/.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend _is_placeholder to recognize 're_' + repeated 'x' pattern. Ship .env.example with RESEND_API_KEY empty.
findings.impact_on_trading: Observability: silent alert outage on fresh deploys.

findings.title: _periodic_cleanup mutates tick_aggregator._history (private)
findings.description: Reaches into private attribute and rebinds. Refactor of TickAggregator that changes internal storage will break the cleanup silently.
findings.suggested_fix: Add TickAggregator.cap_history(max_per_symbol) public method.

findings.title: Portfolio._maybe_persist_trade opens its own raw sqlite3 connection
findings.description: Bypasses Database class for an existence-check + INSERT. Diverges silently if Database moves to a pooled connection model. Existence check and store_trade run in two different connections; subtly racy under concurrent writers.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Database.store_trade_if_absent(record_dict) and use it.

findings.title: profit_factor returns float('inf') when gross_loss == 0; not JSON-safe
findings.description: Strict JSON encoders reject Infinity (Python json emits 'Infinity', invalid per RFC 8259). Flows into AlertManager.send_daily_report and any cloud-sync of metrics.
findings.suggested_fix: Use None when gross_loss == 0; surface 'no losing trades' in renderer.

findings.title: require_nifty_above_200ema default in code is True, config ships False
findings.description: Defaults disagree between code and config. A fresh deploy without the full config.yaml would silently block all longs.
findings.suggested_fix: Align default to False (matching the active config and recent battery evidence).

findings.title: F821 Undefined name Position in forward type-hint (cosmetic)
findings.description: pos: 'Position' is a string annotation; Position is not imported. No runtime impact, but mypy --strict fails.
findings.suggested_fix: Add TYPE_CHECKING import of Position from core.portfolio.

findings.title: AngelOne IP-whitelist diagnostic uses urllib.request.urlopen, bypassing fixed-SSL config
findings.description: Bandit B310. Only runs on AB1050 error path. With the global SSL monkey-patch from main.py, validates against any cert.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with requests.get('https://api.ipify.org?format=json', timeout=5).

findings.title: pickle / torch.load(weights_only=False) allow arbitrary code execution on tampered model files
findings.description: Bandit B301/B614. Local files only; requires write access to models/ to exploit.
findings.suggested_fix: Migrate to safetensors / xgboost native JSON; for pickles add SHA-256 manifest verification on load.

findings.title: B904 lost exception context in run_battery_queue.py
findings.description: raise X(...) inside except clause without 'from err'.
findings.suggested_fix: Mechanical: raise X(...) from err.

findings.title: Code-hygiene noise (119 F401, 18 F841, 60 E402, 47 SIM105, 10 E741)
findings.description: Mostly mechanical fixes via ruff --fix on safe rules. Counts from ruff statistics; full breakdown in logs/ruff_report.txt.
findings.suggested_fix: ruff check --fix --select F401,F541,UP,I,SIM118; review and commit.

tests_to_add.assert: On simulated post-commit timeout, only one logical order exists in broker order book after retries.
AST parse of market_safety.py finds no duplicate string keys in any Dict literal.
max(NSE_HOLIDAYS) >= today + 180 days, else descriptive critical-level log.
Identical seed + inputs => identical filled_price + filled_quantity.
Two concurrent processes each calling send_alert => underlying email backend called exactly once.
json.dumps(get_performance_metrics()) does not raise; profit_factor is None or finite float.
